## ✨ Feature Request

### Problem Statement
A clear description of the problem this feature would solve.
*Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."*

### Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Use Case
Who would benefit from this feature and how?

### Additional Context
Add any mockups, screenshots, or examples from other tools.

### Checklist
- [ ] I've searched existing issues to make sure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] This feature aligns with Ephe's principles (offline-first defaults, privacy, explicit opt-in for online features)
